publicationDateRule: Set immediately before the sole combined push to the UTC date on which each route first passes public verification.

articles.title: Build an exchange-rate evidence packet for a foreign-currency invoice
articles.readerOutcome: Separate the invoice currency, functional-currency translation inputs, rate source, effective date, and finance decision without letting AP support choose accounting policy.

articles.title: Review a supplier invoice contact change without weakening payment controls
articles.readerOutcome: Authenticate a changed billing contact, preserve the old contact history, and keep contact maintenance separate from bank-detail authority.

articles.title: Resolve an invoice exception after a purchase order line is closed
articles.readerOutcome: Reconstruct receipts, reversals, invoices, commitments, and closure authority before an owner decides whether to reopen or replace the line.

articles.title: Check for duplicate invoices across related legal entities
articles.readerOutcome: Compare normalized invoice evidence across entity ledgers while preserving legal-entity ownership and approval boundaries.

articles.title: Age and resolve unapplied supplier credit memos
articles.readerOutcome: Trace each credit to its cause, eligible invoices, restrictions, owner, and supplier application rather than treating the balance as generic cash.

articles.title: Review accessorial charges on a freight invoice
articles.readerOutcome: Connect detention, liftgate, redelivery, and other extra charges to shipment events, contracted terms, and commercial approval.

articles.title: Maintain a cutoff exception log for payment proposal preparation
articles.readerOutcome: Document additions, removals, holds, timing changes, approvals, and final inclusion without giving the preparer release authority.

articles.title: Build a vendor tax-document expiry and refresh queue
articles.readerOutcome: Track document type, receipt, review owner, expiry trigger, outreach, and unresolved status while leaving tax conclusions to authorized specialists.

articles.title: Follow up a merchant credit on an employee expense report
articles.readerOutcome: Link the original charge, return evidence, expected credit, card statement, and employee response without netting unrelated expenses.

articles.title: Triage bounced and undeliverable messages from the AP mailbox
articles.readerOutcome: Distinguish address errors, security rejections, supplier-domain changes, and closed cases while using verified contact paths.

articles.title: Prepare a goods-received-not-invoiced review packet for close
articles.readerOutcome: Reconcile receipts, returns, expected invoices, service evidence, supplier follow-up, and finance ownership for cutoff decisions.

articles.title: Review dispute milestones before escalating an aged invoice
articles.readerOutcome: Measure age from meaningful events, identify the current decision owner, and avoid escalating invoices that await a documented supplier correction.
